description: The objective of the Framework Contract is to support EDA and Member States in elaborating the implementation of the CapTech Missiles & Munitions (CapTech M&M) Strategic Research Agenda (SRA) regarding the technological development in AI technologies and how to integrate such into the development of M&M systems. The framework contract shall provide an overview of which areas within the defined areas of interest of the CapTech are interesting to review deeper and are interesting for AI and ML. Its purpose is to create a link to the CapTech SRA, obtain engagement from the Cap Tech M&M community and be a support for the Workshop (hybrid or on-line), which shall be held (see Task 1.5 below). The result from the framework contract shall support the Member States in planning future usage of AI in M&M including relevant applications for research and development. Also to: • Identify collaborative opportunities addressing M&M. • Support implementation of the relevant Capability Development Priorities by validating technical options for enhanced autonomy and increased performance that could be considered within the relevant Priority Implementation Roadmaps
